objections.rationale: Turn 2 answers directly and without defensiveness: "You submitted a refinance inquiry on our website a moment ago, and I'm following up on it." It also reminds the borrower of the opt-out ("just reply STOP") and then re-asks permission to continue. This matches the playbook exactly.

Asked "am I talking to a real person or a bot?", the agent answered plainly: "I'm an automated assistant, not a person." It added "you can ask for a person at any time" and moved straight into the first question. The borrower responded "ok thanks for being upfront."

judge.naturalness_rationale: Messages are short, one question per text, and warm, with nice touches like "A ballpark is fine" and "Last question." It loses a point for the formulaic "Got it."/"Thanks." opener on nearly every turn. Turn 18 also ignores the borrower's volunteered goal ("kitchen remodel and pay off my car"), so the close reads slightly scripted.
judge.experience_rationale: The borrower went from suspicious (turn 1) to appreciative (turn 5) thanks to honest answers. Turn 18 states who will call, how ("at this number"), and when ("usually within 5 minutes"). It also sets honest expectations that the loan officer "may want to double-check a few things, like your home value and balance."
judge.handoff_summary_rationale: All fields match the transcript: $60k cash-out, $400k value, $210k balance, 6.5% rate, 680-739 credit, primary residence, within 3 months. It captures the stated purpose (kitchen remodel, car payoff), both objections, and actionable open questions. A loan officer could call immediately.

annotations.note: It gives a transparent, non-defensive source for the contact ("You submitted a refinance inquiry on our website a moment ago") plus a STOP reminder, which is exactly the how_got_info playbook.
It answers the bot question honestly ("I'm an automated assistant, not a person") and offers a human at any time, which earned the borrower's trust.
The note "answering it doesn't run a credit check" lowers anxiety about sharing a credit estimate without implying any credit decision.
The close names who, how, and when ("They'll call you at this number, usually within 5 minutes") and avoids promising the borrower won't need to repeat anything.
It skips over the borrower's just-shared reason ("kitchen remodel and pay off my car"), a missed chance for a brief human acknowledgment.

judge.overall_notes: A clean, compliant conversation that turned an initially wary borrower into a warm handoff through honesty about identity and data source. The only polish needed is less formulaic acknowledgments and engaging with the borrower's stated goals.
